summary: This standards-track memo specifies RTP payload formats for carrying ETSI Distributed Speech Recognition features (the ES 202 050, 202 211 and 202 212 front-ends). They let speech features be sent over the Internet so recognition can be done remotely.

eli5.summary: Instead of sending your whole voice, a phone sends a compact summary of sounds to a computer that figures out the words. This document says how to put that summary in internet packets.

questions: rtp payload for distributed speech recognition
